an6.13:1.4: mettā hi kho me cetovimutti bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā
an6.13:1.5: atha ca pana me byāpādo cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatīti
an6.13:1.6: so mā hevantissa vacanīyo mā āyasmā evaṃ avaca mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya
an6.13:1.7: aṭṭhānametaṃ āvuso anavakāso yaṃ mettāya cetovimuttiyā bhāvitāya bahulīkatāya yānīkatāya vatthukatāya anuṭṭhitāya paricitāya susamāraddhāya
an6.13:1.8: atha ca panassa byāpādo cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati
an6.13:1.9: nissaraṇañhetaṃ āvuso byāpādassa yadidaṃ mettā cetovimutti.
an6.13:2.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya
an6.13:2.2: karuṇā hi kho me cetovimutti bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā
an6.13:2.3: atha ca pana me vihesā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatīti
an6.13:2.4: so mā hevantissa vacanīyo mā āyasmā evaṃ avaca mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya
an6.13:2.5: aṭṭhānametaṃ āvuso anavakāso yaṃ karuṇāya cetovimuttiyā bhāvitāya bahulīkatāya yānīkatāya vatthukatāya anuṭṭhitāya paricitāya susamāraddhāya
an6.13:2.6: atha ca panassa vihesā cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati
an6.13:2.7: nissaraṇañhetaṃ āvuso vihesāya yadidaṃ karuṇā cetovimutti.
an6.13:3.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya
an6.13:3.2: muditā hi kho me cetovimutti bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā
an6.13:3.3: atha ca pana me arati cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatīti
an6.13:3.4: so mā hevantissa vacanīyo mā āyasmā evaṃ avaca mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya
an6.13:3.5: aṭṭhānametaṃ āvuso anavakāso yaṃ muditāya cetovimuttiyā bhāvitāya bahulīkatāya yānīkatāya vatthukatāya anuṭṭhitāya paricitāya susamāraddhāya
an6.13:3.6: atha ca panassa arati cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati
an6.13:3.7: nissaraṇañhetaṃ āvuso aratiyā yadidaṃ muditā cetovimutti.
an6.13:4.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya
an6.13:4.2: upekkhā hi kho me cetovimutti bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā
an6.13:4.3: atha ca pana me rāgo cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatīti
an6.13:4.4: so mā hevantissa vacanīyo mā āyasmā evaṃ avaca mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya
an6.13:4.5: aṭṭhānametaṃ āvuso anavakāso yaṃ upekkhāya cetovimuttiyā bhāvitāya bahulīkatāya yānīkatāya vatthukatāya anuṭṭhitāya paricitāya susamāraddhāya
an6.13:4.6: atha ca panassa rāgo cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati
an6.13:4.7: nissaraṇañhetaṃ āvuso rāgassa yadidaṃ upekkhā cetovamutti.
an6.13:5.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya
an6.13:5.2: animittā hi kho me cetovimutti bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā
an6.13:5.3: atha ca pana me nimittānusāri viññāṇaṃ hotīti
an6.13:5.4: so mā hevantissa vacanīyo mā āyasmā evaṃ avaca mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya
an6.13:5.5: aṭṭhānametaṃ āvuso anavakāso yaṃ animittāya cetovimuttiyā bhāvitāya bahulīkatāya yānīkatāya vatthukatāya anuṭṭhitāya paricitāya susamāraddhāya
an6.13:5.6: atha ca panassa nimittānusāri viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati
an6.13:5.7: nissaraṇañhetaṃ āvuso sabbanimittānaṃ yadidaṃ animittā cetovimutti.
an6.13:6.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya
an6.13:6.2: assamīti kho me vigate ayamahamasmīti ca na samanupassāmi
an6.13:6.3: atha ca pana me vicikicchākathaṃkathāsallaṃ cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatīti
an6.13:6.4: so mā hevantissa vacanīyo mā āyasmā evaṃ avaca mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya
an6.13:6.5: aṭṭhānametaṃ āvuso anavakāso yaṃ asmīti vigate ayamahamasmīti ca asamanupassato
an6.13:6.6: atha ca panassa vicikicchākathaṃkathāsallaṃ cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati
an6.13:6.7: nissaraṇañhetaṃ āvuso vicikicchākathaṃkathāsallassa yadidaṃ asmīti mānasamugghāto.
an6.13:7.1: imā kho bhikkhave cha nissāraṇiyā dhātuyoti.
